page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.24xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz. It provides 96 dedicated vCPUs paired with 768.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio equivalent to 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The server does not incorporate hardware graphics processing units.

From an infrastructure integration perspective, ecs.r9i.24xlarge contains no bundled local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of network storage volumes for OS installation and persistent data hosting. Networking capacity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput node communications. The configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires routing through virtual private network gateways or external IP allocation for public ingress and egress.

The dense memory allocation relative to compute capacity makes this server suited for in-memory databases, large-scale caching engines, distributed memory compute nodes, and massive enterprise transactional workloads. Because it provides dedicated compute resources and substantial RAM density, it offers operational efficiency for scale-up architectures by consolidating memory-bound tasks into a single high-capacity virtual instance.
